basic_details.job_title: IISc Psychiatric Social Worker Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online

important_dates.interview_date: To be intimated separately to shortlisted candidates

age_limit.details: The maximum age limit is 45 years as on the last date of receipt of the application (28.10.2026). Age relaxation as per GoI norms (if applicable) will be extended.

qualification.details: Only Indian nationals are eligible to apply.

salary_details.details: Except for the consolidated and fixed emoluments, no other benefits will be extended. No claim for any service benefits like PF, Pension, Medical Allowance, Seniority & Promotion, etc., from this contract appointment will be admissible. An increment of up to 10% is admissible in the case of extension, based on the performance of the candidate and the recommendation of the Chairperson of the Wellness Centre.

selection_process: The selection process consists of the shortlisting of applications followed by an interview.
Shortlisted candidates will be called for an interview

which may be conducted in person or via an electronic mode (Zoom Call/Microsoft Teams). Candidates must be prepared to give interviews in all media if required. No TA/DA shall be paid for attending an in-person interview.
how_to_apply: Visit the official temporary positions portal at recruitment.iisc.ac.in/Temporary_Positions/.
Fill out the online application form carefully with correct details.
Attach the required certificates in support of age, category, qualification, marks, disability, and experience.
Submit the online application on or before 28.10.2026.
Take a printout of the online submitted application for future reference.
important_instructions: The candidate must possess the essential prescribed qualifications on or before the last date of submitting the application. Engagement is purely temporary on a contract basis, initially for a period of one year and renewable annually up to a maximum duration of five years. Wellness coordinators are required to be available on campus on all working days and on Saturdays for the campus Institute community, and available to attend emergencies at any time. If selected, the candidate must join immediately. Accommodation will be provided on the Institute campus in the hostel during the course of your stay. The contract can be terminated at any time by giving one month’s notice by either side. Applications should be sent well in advance, without waiting till the last date. No hardcopy submission of the online submitted application is accepted.

content_sections.heading: IISc Psychiatric Social Worker Vacancy Details (Category-wise)
content_sections.text: There are a total of 2 vacancies available for the Psychiatric Social Worker (PSW) position at the IISc Wellness Centre. Note: Male candidates preferred, based on job requirement.

content_sections.heading: IISc Psychiatric Social Worker Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Only Indian nationals are eligible to apply.

rows.qualification_required: Essential qualification: M. Phil in Psychiatric Social Work. Desirable qualification: One year of relevant experience.

content_sections.heading: IISc Psychiatric Social Worker Age Limit
content_sections.text: The maximum age limit is 45 years as on the last date of receipt of the application (28.10.2026). Age relaxation as per GoI norms (if applicable) will be extended.

content_sections.heading: IISc Psychiatric Social Worker Salary
content_sections.text: Except for the consolidated and fixed emoluments, no other benefits will be extended. No claim for any service benefits like PF, Pension, Medical Allowance, Seniority & Promotion, etc., from this contract appointment will be admissible. An increment of up to 10% is admissible in the case of extension, based on the performance of the candidate and the recommendation of the Chairperson of the Wellness Centre.

content_sections.heading: IISc Psychiatric Social Worker Selection Process
content_sections.text: The selection process consists of the shortlisting of applications followed by an interview. Shortlisted candidates will be called for an interview, which may be conducted in person or via an electronic mode (Zoom Call/Microsoft Teams). Candidates must be prepared to give interviews in all media if required. No TA/DA shall be paid for attending an in-person interview.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for IISc Psychiatric Social Worker
content_sections.text: Visit the official temporary positions portal at recruitment.iisc.ac.in/Temporary_Positions/ . Fill out the online application form carefully with correct details. Attach the required certificates in support of age, category, qualification, marks, disability, and experience. Submit the online application on or before 28.10.2026. Take a printout of the online submitted application for future reference.

content_sections.heading: IISc Psychiatric Social Worker Important Instructions
content_sections.text: The candidate must possess the essential prescribed qualifications on or before the last date of submitting the application. Engagement is purely temporary on a contract basis, initially for a period of one year and renewable annually up to a maximum duration of five years. Wellness coordinators are required to be available on campus on all working days and on Saturdays for the campus Institute community, and available to attend emergencies at any time. If selected, the candidate must join immediately. Accommodation will be provided on the Institute campus in the hostel during the course of your stay. The contract can be terminated at any time by giving one month’s notice by either side. Applications should be sent well in advance, without waiting till the last date. No hardcopy submission of the online submitted application is accepted.

faq.question: Q1. What is IISc Psychiatric Social Worker Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: It is an official recruitment notification released by the Indian Institute of Science, Bengaluru, to hire 2 Psychiatric Social Workers for its Wellness Centre on a temporary contract basis.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available under this recruitment?
faq.answer: There are a total of 2 vacancies, categorized as Unreserved (UR): 01 and Scheduled Caste (SC): 01.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply online?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application form is 28.10.2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the essential qualification required for the Psychiatric Social Worker post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess an M.Phil in Psychiatric Social Work. One year of relevant experience is listed as a desirable qualification.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for applicants?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit is 45 years as on the last date of receipt of the application, with age relaxations as per GoI norms.

faq.question: Q6. What is the monthly salary offered?
faq.answer: Selected candidates will receive consolidated emoluments of Rs. 48,000/- per month.

faq.question: Q7. Is there any application fee?
faq.answer: The notification does not mention any application fee.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process?
faq.answer: Shortlisted candidates will be called for an interview, which may be held in person or via electronic modes like Zoom or Microsoft Teams.

faq.question: Q9. What is the duration of the contract?
faq.answer: The engagement is purely temporary on a contract basis for an initial period of one year, renewable annually up to a maximum duration of five years based on performance.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I apply online?
faq.answer: Eligible candidates can apply online through the official recruitment portal at recruitment.iisc.ac.in/Temporary_Positions/.
